exposure: Age range of introduction for different food groups: < 2 months, 2-4 months, and 4-6 months
infant pacifier use at 2 months of age
outcome: Timing of introduction for different food groups: formulas, other milks, other beverages, solids and semi-solids
finding: The determinants of early complementary feeding introduction (CFI) varied according to the type of food and the age of introduction, with factors like primiparity, employment status, and cesarean section increasing the risk of early formula introduction.
mod_finding: Mothers who had cesarean sections were more likely to introduce formula before 2 months of age.
